hero.title: Empowering Every
hero.subtitle: Designed to support every aspect of your life - Physical, Mental and Financial. Because true success begins with holistic wellbeing.

physical.title: Physical Wellness
physical.subtitle: Invest in your health with programs designed to energize, strengthen and sustain your lifestyle.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Why settle for one gym when you can have them all? We’ve partnered with Cult.fit to give you an all-access pass to India’s premium fitness ecosystem. Whether you’re at home or traveling, your workout never skips a beat.
bulletPoints: Walk into any Cult center across the country, your membership travels with you
From high-intensity HRX and boxing to yoga and dance plus badminton and swimming, find the fitness style that fuels your passion

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS Club Verse brings teams together through sports, wellness and friendly competition. From tournaments to fitness activities, these events create opportunities to connect, collaborate and stay active.
bulletPoints: Inter-team sports tournaments throughout the year
Fun, wellness and fitness engagement activities
Opportunities to build team spirit and collaboration
Event announcements and updates shared on Zoho Connect

modalDetails.fullDescription: Good nutrition fuels great performance. To make healthy eating easier and more convenient, FYERS provides nutritious weekday meals with a 50% subsidy.
bulletPoints: 50% meal subsidy co-contributed by FYERS and members, encouraging mindful consumption and helping reduce food wastage while continuing to make healthy meals accessible to everyone
Nutritious meals with no maida or refined sugar, featuring millets and brown rice, along with calorie information for every meal
Choice of veg and non-veg healthy meal options, available Monday to Friday
Convenient pre-ordering through our partner app - Hunger Box

benefits.title: Festive Menu
benefits.desc: Celebrate Cultures and Seasons Through Food.

modalDetails.fullDescription: While our daily meals focus on healthy and balanced nutrition, festive menus are our way of adding a little indulgence to the mix. Think of them as well-deserved cheat meals, bringing together rich flavors, traditional recipes and the joy of celebration across cultures.
bulletPoints: Festive menus introduced during key festivals and seasonal occasions
Indulgent cheat meal experiences alongside everyday healthy meals
Traditional and regional delicacies from across India, opportunity to explore diverse seasonal cuisines
Company-wide potluck across all locations, brings teams together through shared food and celebrations

modalDetails.fullDescription: Through our partnership with Practo, members and their families can access verified doctors across multiple specialties anytime, anywhere.
bulletPoints: Unlimited online consultations for your family
Access to 24+ medical specialties and 1L+ doctors across India
Audio, video, or chat consultation options
Connect with a doctor 24/7
Coverage for up to 4 adults and 2 children
Veterinary consultations included
Up to 20% discount on medicines and lab tests
Up to 10% discount on clinic visits

benefits.title: Discounted Health Checkup
benefits.desc: Stay on Top of Your Health.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Take proactive care of your well-being with access to health, eye and dental check-ups available through Employee Health section on the Ethika portal. These services help ensure you and your insured dependents stay healthy and supported.
bulletPoints: Health check-ups for insured individuals
Eye check-up services
Dental check-up services
Easy access through -  fyers.ethika.in

benefits.title: Annual Health Camp
benefits.desc: Proactive Care for a Healthier You.

modalDetails.fullDescription: An annual preventive health camp is organized to help members stay ahead of potential health risks through early screenings and diagnostics. It’s an opportunity to check in on your health and take proactive steps toward long-term well-being.
bulletPoints: Company-organized annual preventive health camp
Supports timely and proactive diagnosis
₹2,000 reimbursement for members outside Bengaluru
Reports and diagnosis remains confidential

mental.title: Mental Wellness
mental.subtitle: Prioritize your inner balance and emotional resilience.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Leave Program
benefits.desc: Time Off That Supports Life Beyond Work.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Our leave policies are designed to give you the flexibility to rest, recharge and take care of life’s important moments while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
bulletPoints: Public Holidays
15 days Privilege Leave (carry forward up to 30 days)
12 days Sick Leave each year
Birthday Leave : 1 paid day to celebrate you
Wedding Leave : 1 paid day
Maternity Leave : 26 weeks / Adoption Leave as per the act
Paternity / Adoption Leave : 15 days ( can be taken within 6 months)
Compensatory Off for work on weekends or public holidays
Bereavement Leave : members may take up to 3 days of leave in a year in the event of the loss of an immediate family member (spouse, children, siblings, parents or parents-in-law)

modalDetails.fullDescription: Recognizing the impact of daily commutes and the importance of maintaining a healthy work-life balance, this Work From Home benefit is designed to give you the flexibility you need—when you need it. It empowers you to WFH with the same efficiency by staying connected, collaborative and productive as a team.
bulletPoints: Up to 4 Work From Home days per month
Easy request submission through the Zoho People - WFH & Leave module
WFH cannot be used as a substitute for leave and cannot be carried forward
This benefit is tailored for flexible work roles with Customer Success, Sales, Quality and Facilities teams continuing their valuable onsite contributions

modalDetails.fullDescription: Conscious Corner brings expert-led sessions focused on mental health awareness, emotional wellbeing, Physical and Financial best practices webinar by Industry experts helping members build resilience and maintain balance.
bulletPoints: Expert-led wellness webinar
Updates and resources shared on Zoho Connect

modalDetails.fullDescription: In line with our commitment to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace, the Women’s Wellness initiative is designed to acknowledge and support the natural health needs of our women members. It enables them to prioritize their wellbeing with dignity, comfort and ease.
bulletPoints: 1 day of paid Women’s Wellness Leave each month, to be availed within the same month
Auto-approved leave which ensures privacy
Seamless application through the Zoho Leave module
Sanitary napkin dispensers, hygiene disposal bins & Disinfectant sprays available in all restrooms

benefits.title: Grievance Redressal
benefits.desc: A Safe Space to Raise Concerns.

modalDetails.fullDescription: We are committed to maintaining a respectful and supportive workplace. Members can raise concerns or grievances through a structured and confidential process designed to ensure fair and timely resolution.
bulletPoints: HR acknowledgement within 48 working hours
A structured and transparent resolution process
Strict confidentiality maintained throughout
Submit concerns via Grievance Community

benefits.title: Harassment-Free Workplace
benefits.desc: A Culture of Respect and Safety.

modalDetails.fullDescription: We are committed to creating a workplace where every member feels safe, respected and valued. Our policies ensure a professional environment built on dignity, inclusion and mutual respect.
bulletPoints: Zero tolerance for harassment and discrimination
Full compliance with PoSH Act
Protection against Work place harassment
Ability to report concerns directly: Click here

modalDetails.fullDescription: We believe achievements deserve recognition and moments of celebration. From milestone events to team outings, these activities bring members together and strengthen our collaborative culture.
bulletPoints: Milestone celebrations recognizing FYERS achievement
Team outings and dinners to connect beyond work
Engaging team-building activities
Event updates and announcements shared on Zoho Connect

financial.title: Financial Wellness
financial.subtitle: Build security, stability, and long-term prosperity.

modalDetails.fullDescription: To support members and their families during medical emergencies, comprehensive Group Medical Insurance coverage is provided for hospitalization due to illness, disease or injury.
bulletPoints: ₹5,00,000 medical insurance coverage per member & their dependence
Protection against hospitalization expenses due to illness or injury
Coverage applicable as per policy terms and conditions
Enjoy cashless treatment at network hospitals, easily accessible via the Ethika portal

modalDetails.fullDescription: This provides financial protection to members in the event of accidental injury, disability or death, ensuring support for members and their families during unforeseen situations.
bulletPoints: ₹30,00,000 coverage for accidental death or disability
Coverage for permanent or partial disability
Comprehensive protection for members
Coverage applicable as per policy terms and conditions

benefits.title: Group Term Insurance
benefits.desc: Financial Protection for Your Loved Ones.

modalDetails.fullDescription: To provide peace of mind and long-term security, Group Term Life Insurance ensures financial protection for your family in the event of unforeseen circumstances.
bulletPoints: 3× base salary coverage for career level 8 and below
5× base salary coverage for career level 9 and above
Financial protection and support for your dependents
Coverage applicable as per policy terms and conditions

benefits.title: Retirement Benefits
benefits.desc: Secure Your Future with Long-Term Savings.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Our retiral benefits are designed to help members build financial stability for the future while ensuring compliance with statutory requirements.
bulletPoints: Retirement Savings: Employer contribution to Provident Fund (EPF)
Pension scheme allocation (EPS)
Long-Term Security & Benefits: Life insurance coverage for added protection (EDLI)
Gratuity (5+ years): Recognizing members’ long-term contribution, paid as per the Gratuity Act

modalDetails.fullDescription: Eligible members can opt for a company-supported car leasing program that offers flexibility and financial advantages while owning a vehicle.
bulletPoints: Applicable for career level 6 and above
A tax-efficient way to upgrade your drive while maximizing your savings

modalDetails.fullDescription: Employee State Insurance provides essential social security benefits that support members and their families during medical or financial emergencies.
bulletPoints: Comprehensive Health & Disability Coverage: Includes sickness, maternity and disability benefits to ensure member well-being
Statutory bonus as per Code on Wages

benefits.title: Employee Referral Program
benefits.desc: Help Build Our Team & Get Rewarded.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Know someone who would be a great fit? Refer talented candidates and earn exciting rewards when they successfully join the team.
bulletPoints: Up to ₹30,000 referral bonus for non-technical roles
Up to ₹60,000 referral bonus for technical roles
Rewards paid in two stages (3 months & 6 months)
Referrals submitted through Zoho Recruit

modalDetails.fullDescription: Balancing work and family is important. This benefit helps working parents manage childcare expenses with monthly creche reimbursements.
bulletPoints: Up to ₹8,000 per month per child
Applicable for children up to 6 years of age
Submit bills and birth certificate for reimbursement
Claims processed through Zoho Expense

modalDetails.fullDescription: Members are encouraged to enhance their professional skills through external courses, certifications and conferences. This program helps support continuous learning and career development.
bulletPoints: Available after 6 months of service, subject to manager and department head approval and based on role requirements
Submit receipts and completion certificates via Zoho Expense

modalDetails.fullDescription: We organize fully funded learning opportunities to help members stay updated with the latest industry knowledge and skills.
bulletPoints: FYERS Product Certified (FPC): A mandatory program to help every member master our platform
Sessions conducted by internal and external experts
Company-sponsored training programs like NISM & more
Easy access to modules to refer to on Zoho Learn

leadership.title: Leadership Benefits
leadership.subtitle: Build security, stability and long-term prosperity.

benefits.title: Elite Chauffeur Service
benefits.desc: Drive Like Royalty – Your Personal Chauffeur Awaits!

modalDetails.fullDescription: Leaders are the heartbeat of success and we treat you like the legends you are! Step into ultimate luxury with a dedicated, six-step safety-screened chauffeur who ferries you and your entire family in complete comfort.
bulletPoints: 12 flexible hours a day, 6 days a week
Company pays every rupee – hiring & salary
You hand-pick your chauffeur before we hire
Seamless replacements if needed

modalDetails.fullDescription: Keep the momentum going with zero worries! As leaders, claim up to ₹10,000 per month towards fuel.
bulletPoints: Up to ₹10,000 per month fuel reimbursement - claim it every single month
Exclusive for our rockstar leaders at Career Level 9+ working out of office
Super-easy claims via ZOHO Expenses - just upload car registration details & fuel bills
Vehicle must be registered in members name

modalDetails.fullDescription: Your family’s love and sacrifices power your greatness, now it’s time to celebrate them in style! Travel the world (or India) with your loved ones and get up to ₹3,00,000
bulletPoints: Air, land, sea travel - domestic or international
Hotels, resorts, meals, visa charges - everything covered
Family = Self + Spouse + Children + Parents + In-Laws
Submit travel plan & bills via ZOHO Expense

benefits.title: FYERS Champion
benefits.desc: For Those Who Raise the Bar.

modalDetails.fullDescription: This is for the game-changers. The ones who consistently go the extra mile, think differently and create real impact. If you’re someone who brings creativity, delivers excellence and truly lives the FYERS values - this spotlight is yours.
bulletPoints: A well-deserved recognition of your journey, achievements and impact
Rewards worth ₹1,00,000 (gift vouchers/cash/vacations & more)
When it happens: Twice a year - because excellence deserves to be celebrated often
Who makes it happen: Nominated by your peers, recognized by leadership - making it truly meaningful

benefits.title: FYERS Force
benefits.desc: When Teams Win, We Celebrate Bigger .

modalDetails.fullDescription: Great things happen when teams come together and this award is all about that collective magic. From collaboration to innovation, this recognizes teams that turn ideas into impact and move FYERS forward together.
bulletPoints: ₹1,50,000 worth of rewards - think team outings/celebrations/vouchers and more
Recognition for every team member who made it happen
When it happens: Twice a year - because success is sweeter when shared
Who makes it happen: Reporting managers lead the way, with the power to nominate talent from any team or entity, ensuring no great impact goes unnoticed.

benefits.title: Spot Award
benefits.desc: For Wins That Deserve Instant Applause.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Not all achievements wait for a big stage - some deserve recognition right away. SPOT Awards are all about celebrating those moments where you step up, stand out and make an immediate impact.
bulletPoints: FYERS Values Ambassador: Our very own Brand Ambassador of showcasing our culture, leading by example in every interaction
FYERS Rising Star:  Recognizing emerging talent who demonstrate exceptional potential and rapid professional growth
FYERS Flash of Brilliance:  Celebrating moments of high-impact innovation and creative problem-solving
FYERS Exceptional Team Player:  Honoring those who go above and beyond to support their peers and drive collective success
Recognition Certificate & ₹5,000 Gift Vouchers

modalDetails.fullDescription: Sometimes, a simple thank you means everything. This initiative makes it easy to appreciate your colleagues - across teams, roles and levels - anytime you feel someone made a difference.
bulletPoints: It builds a culture where appreciation flows freely and every effort feels valued
4 winners selected every quarter through a raffle draw, receive ₹2,000 gift vouchers
